subject: Procurement manifest: Renewal + capacity increase — approvals & portal steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement manifest: Renewal + capacity increase — approvals & portal steps

Hi Taylor,

Thanks again for the time last week — glad Nimbus is moving forward with the renewal and the planned capacity increase for Q4. To keep procurement timelines tight on your side, I wanted to surface a suggested procurement "manifest" (steps we usually follow) so we can get your procurement portal items lined up and avoid last-minute PO/attestation delays.

High-level ask: confirm the procurement owner who will run DocuSign + internal PO creation and whether Nimbus will use your external SSO-based portal or accept our pre-filled PO PDF.

What I can share now:
- Draft SOW (attached, v3) with the agreed term changes (12 -> 24 months, phased seat uplift in month 6)
- Proposed approval matrix (procure_matrix.xlsx) mapping the internal Nimbus approvers we discussed to signatures and estimated lanes (Legal / IT / Finance)
- Typical timeline: 2 weeks to finalize SOW -> 1 week internal approvals -> PO issuance. We can also support a faster lane if DocuSign + procurement portal access is ready.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm procurement contact who will own the portal actions (if different from Taylor).
2) We’ll submit a pre-filled DocuSign envelope and the SOW to your portal for review.
3) If you prefer, Laura will coordinate a short run-through of the portal flow with your procurement admin.

Attaching the SOW and the approval matrix for your procurement team to review. Happy to hop on a 30-min slot this week to walk operations through.

Best,

Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: nimbus_sow_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: procure_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@nimbushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Procurement manifest: Renewal + capacity increase — approvals & portal steps

Thanks Markus — this is helpful.

Quick answers:
- Procurement owner will be me for DocuSign and PO submission, but Maria Chen (procurement@nimbushealth.com) owns the portal and final PO issuance. I’ve looped procurement on this email.
- We prefer to ingest the SOW into our vendor portal (for audit reasons) instead of a pre-filled PO PDF. Can your team upload the SOW and the approval matrix to our portal? I can give a portal upload link if needed.

Couple of questions from Maria (cc'd):
- Does the SOW v3 include the revised uptime SLA verbiage we discussed (99.9% regional, 99.95% global)?
- We need to see an attestation for SOC2 controls applied to the Dedicated deployment. Can you provide the SOC2 cover page and the latest attestation?

We'd like to keep the internal approval window to 10 business days if possible — will your team be able to respond to legal redlines during that window?

Taylor Brooks
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Health
Phone: +1 415-555-0124

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maria Chen <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Aug 2028 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Procurement manifest: Renewal + capacity increase — approvals & portal steps

Hi Maria / Taylor — Laura from Redwood's Contracts & Ops team here.

We can upload the SOW and the approval matrix to your portal. Maria — can you please share the portal upload URL and the preferred file metadata (tagging fields) so we map the SOW title and the attestation doc correctly?

On the items you asked about:
- SLA language: the attached SOW v3 includes the regional/global uptime figures and a short section on credits. If you have specific language your legal team requires, forward redlines and we’ll respond within 3 business days.
- SOC2: we will attach the SOC2 cover letter and the attestation document to the portal upload. For Dedicated deployments we include a controls summary; attaching the redacted attestation as an addendum.

I’ve attached an internal checklist (procure_matrix.xlsx) that maps the approvers to required artifacts to speed your review. Proposed timeline option A (standard): 10 business days for approvals. Option B (accelerated): if Nimbus completes portal upload + provides written legal redlines within 48 hours, we’ll target 4 business days for approvals and PO issuance.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Maria: portal upload link + preferred tags (ACTION: by EOD Wed).
- Taylor: confirm you want Option B and commit to 48-hr redline turnaround.
- Markus: confirm Redwood will prepare a DocuSign envelope as fallback.

Attachments included in upload package: SOW v3, SOC2_attestation_redacted.pdf, procure_matrix.xlsx.

Regards,

Laura Bennett
Sr. Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2_attestation_redacted.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: procure_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Brooks <taylor.brooks@nimbushealth.com>, Maria Chen <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Procurement manifest: Renewal + capacity increase — approvals & portal steps

Thanks everyone — quick status update and commitments so Nimbus can hit your target window: 

- Maria: please send the portal upload link and tagging schema by EOD today.
- Nimbus commits to Option B: Taylor confirmed internal legal will provide redlines within 48 hours of upload.
- Redwood commitments:
  * We will upload SOW v3, the SOC2 attestation (redacted) and the approval matrix to your portal as soon as we have the link.
  * Laura's team will respond to any legal redlines within 3 business days; if you request accelerated handling we’ll prioritize and aim for 24-48hr turnaround.
  * I’ll prepare a DocuSign backup and will not circulate it unless the portal lane stalls beyond 3 business days.

If that aligns, I’ll schedule a 20-minute portal checklist call for Monday to walk Maria through the file tags and expected signers so we can avoid mismatches in the bucketing that often delays approvals.

Final note: we have a PO lane reserved on our side for Nimbus that will allow you to provision the capacity increase as soon as we receive the signed SOW + PO number. Happy to expedite the provisioning once the signature arrives.

Markus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
